title: Protect stale recovery partitioning
root_cause: Recovery behavior had same-stack operational evidence but lacked a focused database regression proving product stale work is separated from retained qualification work.

change.behavior: Added a stale-turn fixture covering a real product project and a bounded Agent2 qualification project; list_stale must partition them without auto-republishing qualification work.

assertions: Product stale candidates remain eligible for recovery.
Partitioning uses persisted project/actor conventions and does not mutate scientific authority.
